services.name: Tandem Skydive
services.desc: Skydive Amelia Island keeps Jacksonville skydiving prices simple: $219 per person plus a $9.95 online booking fee. No deposit required and no hidden resort or gear charges-just one transparent price for a tandem skydive with ocean views over Fernandina Beach and the Atlantic. If you still have questions before you book, check out our first-time skydiving FAQs. Skydive Amelia Island is the place to go for skydiving in Jacksonville, if you are in or around the Jacksonville, FL area. Prices are available for tandem skydiving for one or more people. Your jump will feature a beautiful beach view of Florida’s finest coastline. Whether you’re braving it alone, or dragging your best friend along,

blurb: Guests experience tandem skydiving from over two miles high with USPA-certified instructors, freefalling at speeds over 120 mph, followed by a 5-7 minute canopy ride with ocean views and a gentle beach landing. The experience includes pre-jump instruction, equipment fitting, and a safety briefing. Media packages are available to capture the jump.
